view_pricing.description: Pricing page viewed after Analytics consent.
view_pricing.exactTrigger: The canonical public pricing route initialises after consent.

start_registration.description: A registration submission starts after Analytics consent.
start_registration.exactTrigger: A valid registration form is submitted immediately before the Auth request.

complete_registration.description: The registration request succeeds after Analytics consent.
complete_registration.exactTrigger: Supabase accepts the registration request and the app moves to email verification.

start_checkout.description: Subscription Checkout starts after Analytics consent.
start_checkout.exactTrigger: A valid monthly or annual subscription action invokes the protected Checkout function.

subscription_activated.description: A returned subscription is confirmed active after Analytics consent.
subscription_activated.exactTrigger: A Stripe success return is followed by an active subscription and full entitlement readback.

use_invoice_maker.description: The no-account document maker is used after Analytics consent.
use_invoice_maker.exactTrigger: The first user edit is made in the public generator.

download_invoice.description: A valid public document is sent to the browser print or PDF-save flow after Analytics consent.
download_invoice.exactTrigger: The public generator passes validation and opens the print dialog.

contact_support.description: A support email link is selected after Analytics consent.
contact_support.exactTrigger: A public-site mail link to main@tallyo.co.uk is activated.
